description: Source code for Anthropic API adapter implementing BaseLlmApi interface, handling chat completions, message conversion, streaming, and utility functions.

classes.name: AnthropicApi
classes.description: Implements API interactions with Anthropic, including message conversion, streaming, and request handling.

methods.name: _convertBody
methods.description: Converts OpenAI chat completion body to Anthropic format, applying caching strategy.

methods.name: maxTokensForModel
methods.description: Determines maximum tokens allowed for a given model.

methods.name: _convertToCleanAnthropicBody
methods.description: Transforms OpenAI chat completion parameters into Anthropic message creation parameters.

methods.name: convertMessageContentToBlocks
methods.description: Converts message content into content blocks, handling text and images.

methods.name: getContentBlocksFromChatMessage
methods.description: Extracts content blocks from chat message based on role.

methods.name: _convertMessages
methods.description: Converts array of chat messages into Anthropic message format.

methods.name: handleStreamResponse
methods.description: Handles streaming response, yielding content chunks and usage info.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Generates headers for API requests, including API key and caching.
